help.title: Strata Context: /strata commands
help.status: Short summary: context use, layers, cache hit rate

help.detailFull: Detail plus every message in each foldable range
help.purge: Delete this session's archive files (asks for confirmation)
help.purgeEnded: Delete the archives of ended sessions (asks to confirm)

purge.warning: /strata purge deletes ALL local archive files of THIS session. It cannot be undone: folds and cards already in the conversation stay, but their originals can no longer be restored from the archive (the DSH session log still has the original events).
purge.confirm: To delete them, send: /strata purge confirm
purge.done: Deleted {files} archive files ({mb} MB) for this session. Folds and cards already in the conversation stay; their originals can no longer be restored from the archive (the DSH session log still has the original events).

detail.title: Strata Context: {state}
detail.ruleOn: at turn end above {pct} after {nudges} unanswered reminders, or above {force}; oldest work first, down to ~{target} (fixed overhead + {targetPct} of the room left)
detail.ruleMidTurn: ; mid-turn above {force}, earlier turns are digested first
detail.netValue: ~{tokens} tokens at the miss price (hit/miss price {ratio})
detail.archiveOver: , above the {cap} MB warning (nothing is deleted; /strata purge ended cleans up)
detail.officialClamped: ; lines lowered to {pct} for this window
detail.officialUnknown: unknown (the window cannot hold output and headroom)
detail.ruleMidTurnCurrent: ; mid-turn above {force}, earlier turns are digested first, then this turn's finished tool rounds
detail.warnConfig: DSH's automatic compaction is off for {target}: {message}
detail.warnOfficial: DSH's official summary (L∞) failed {count} time(s) in a row: {message}

purgeEnded.warning: /strata purge ended deletes the local archives of ended sessions: {sessions} session(s), {mb} MB (not this session, sessions open in this process, or sessions another running DSH is writing). This cannot be undone: if you reopen those sessions, their folds and cards can no longer be restored from the archive (DSH's session log still holds the original events).
purgeEnded.confirm: To delete them, send: /strata purge ended confirm
purgeEnded.done: Deleted the archives of {sessions} ended session(s): {files} files, {mb} MB.
purgeEnded.none: No archives of ended sessions to delete.
